title: Microsoft Tunnel for MAM — Mobile Access to Intranet Resources
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (deploy Microsoft Tunnel Gateway + Tunnel for MAM to route managed mobile-app traffic to internal/intranet resources; server + connector + network + client, higher infra/risk).
hook: Let managed mobile apps reach intranet resources — without a full device VPN
problem: Some corporate resources only live inside the network — an on-prem app, an internal API, a private intranet endpoint — and mobile users on BYOD can't reach them without a VPN you'd rather not put on a personal phone. Microsoft Tunnel for MAM solves this: an app-level VPN that routes traffic from MAM-protected Microsoft 365 (and line-of-business) apps to internal resources, scoped to the app rather than the whole device. This solution gives you a repeatable way to deploy the Microsoft Tunnel Gateway and Tunnel for MAM so managed mobile apps reach intranet resources securely.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how Microsoft Tunnel and Tunnel for MAM work (the Linux-hosted Tunnel Gateway, the connector, split vs. full tunneling), how app-level VPN differs from device VPN, and which apps/resources it fits.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, a supported Linux host / container for the Tunnel Gateway, network/firewall paths to internal resources, certificates, the MAM apps in scope, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: stand up the Tunnel Gateway, configure the server + site + connector, create the Tunnel for MAM configuration, target the MAM apps, validate mobile app access to an internal resource, then pilot and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — Tunnel/MAM readiness discovery, per-device/app tunnel-connectivity validation, a tunnel usage and health report, safe remediation of unhealthy config, and a Tunnel-for-MAM scope-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to deploy Microsoft Tunnel and Tunnel for MAM — an app-level VPN that routes MAM-protected mobile-app traffic to internal/intranet resources, scoped to the app rather than the whole device. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
